## Activity

During October 2022, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 369 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and indicates the volume of imaging completed by the clinic team. The figure should be retained as the overall capture count for October 2022.

## Image quality

Of the 369 captures, 25 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.8. This result identifies the proportion of captures that could not be assessed for grading purposes. Image quality should continue to be monitored alongside the capture total so that changes in the rate can be identified in future reporting periods.

## Grading

Grading identified 83 referable results during October 2022. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This provides the central measure of the time taken for grading during the reporting period. The activity, image quality and grading figures should be considered together when reviewing the service delivered by West Gate Eye Clinic.
